answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 26041 Country: India Title: Under what conditions we have to offer gusul in islam? Question: under what conditions we have to offer gusul in islam.... Answer ID: 26041 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1739/1370/B=1431) When one discharges semen with lust i.e. due to having intercourse with wife or had wet dream, or masturbated or sodomized or a woman became paak (clean) from menstruation or nifas (postpartum blood), in all these cases, ghusl will be fardh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
